item: OSM reference run onto the shared passphrase scrub
key_paths: src/osm/reference_run.py src/osm/ingest.py src/osm/history.py src/osm/completeness.py scripts/osm_reference_run.py scripts/osm_ingest.py scripts/osm_history_ingest.py scripts/build_place_gazetteer.py tests/test_osm_reference_run.py tests/test_osm_child_error_text.py tests/test_p0_validation.py
summary: The runner's texts go through secret_scrub: scrub() calls scrubbed (every shape of the throwaway key plus every passphrase the process holds, a too-short secret withholding the text); its two exception handlers, the command's refusal lines and the children's own error texts (ingest and history reports, the two ingest scripts and the gazetteer build, each wholly under one handler) and the admin-1 count's stored error write exception_text; the children's and the app's log lines for a failure use log_failure, not exc_info (a UnicodeError by class alone); the keys of a child's JSON are scrubbed and kept apart when they collide; the finished report keeps a paths-only pass; any store that is left (kept, survived, or half-deleted) has the children's raw logs deleted, and the third signal removes them too (after arming the default action, so a blocked removal cannot hold the process); and the module moves into the guarded modules of the passphrase-handler walk, which now reads a secret held as a starred tuple. Each of these fails a named test when removed (checked by mutation): the held passphrase, the short secret, the finished pass, the key scrub, the log removal (kept, half-deleted, third signal), the country refusal line (held passphrase and a UnicodeError case), the command's handler width (a crash is typed, exit 1), the child's and the admin-1 error texts and log lines, each script's whole-main handler, and the UnicodeError class-only form; the hand-made handler form fails only the UnicodeError tests and the guard row, since the later scrub still removes the key.
